versions.changelog: Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching — now reproduces census commute totals between districts exactly and evens out block-to-block variation within each city. Resident and job placement evened out across medium-density neighborhoods. Map geometry recomputed in the map's local projection for more accurate shapes and smaller tiles, with a lighter download and a wider default initial view.

Full modeling refresh — per-building foundation depth, Global Building Atlas building heights, fuller land use, and greatly expanded cultural and entertainment demand from prefectural and municipal statistics. Metropolitan boundary substantially widened.
New in 0.3.3. Includes bathymetric data and cultural attraction special demand
